drug_class: Combination antibiotic and corticosteroid ear preparation
purpose: This medication is used to treat bacterial infections and inflammation in the ear canal. It helps clear up infections while also reducing pain, swelling, and itching in the ear. It is typically used for conditions like swimmer's ear or infections after ear surgery.
how_it_works: This medicine contains two antibiotics — neomycin and colistin — that work together to kill the bacteria causing your ear infection. Hydrocortisone is a mild steroid that calms down the swelling and irritation in your ear. Thonzonium is a special ingredient that helps the other medicines spread and work more effectively inside your ear canal.
common_side_effects: Some people may notice mild burning, stinging, or itching when they first put the drops in. You might also notice a temporary feeling of fullness in the ear. These effects are usually mild and go away quickly.
warnings: Do not use these drops if your eardrum has a hole or has been perforated, unless your doctor specifically tells you it is safe. If you develop a rash, increased pain, or your symptoms get worse instead of better after a few days, contact your doctor right away. Long-term use can sometimes cause a secondary fungal infection in the ear. Do not use in eyes.
typical_dosing: The usual dose for adults is 5 drops placed into the affected ear 3 to 4 times a day. For children, the typical dose is 4 drops, 3 to 4 times daily. Gently tug the ear back before putting in the drops to help them reach deep into the canal. Always follow your doctor's specific instructions, as dosing can vary.
